description: Source code for a custom GPIO-based SPI driver for Linux kernel, including parameter definitions, device registration, and cleanup functions.

methods.name: spi_gpio_custom_cleanup
methods.description: Unregisters all platform devices created by the driver.

methods.name: spi_gpio_custom_get_slave_mode
methods.description: Retrieves the mode configuration for a specific slave on a bus.

methods.name: spi_gpio_custom_get_slave_maxfreq
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum frequency for a specific slave on a bus.

methods.name: spi_gpio_custom_get_slave_cs
methods.description: Retrieves the chip select GPIO for a specific slave.

methods.name: spi_gpio_custom_check_params
methods.description: Validates the parameters for a bus configuration.

methods.name: spi_gpio_custom_add_one
methods.description: Creates and registers a platform device and its slaves based on bus parameters.

methods.name: spi_gpio_custom_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver, registers buses, and creates devices.
